caseName: Ann Arbor Railroad v. United States
caseNameFull: Ann Arbor Railroad Co. v. United States Kansas City Southern Railway Co. v. United States and United States v. Interstate Commerce Commission

opinions.text: Affirmed on appeals from D. C. E. D. Pa. Mr. Justice Douglas would remand No. 73-1670 to the Interstate Commerce Commission for a finding on the reasonableness of the prescribed rate. Mr. Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of these appeals. Reported below: 368 F. Supp. 101.
